lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in four to five roughly parallel longitudinal rows between the carinae, beginning posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity pixel clusters are positioned at the intersections of faint, vertically-oriented bands of higher luminance and the horizontal carinae, forming a grid-like node structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges run along the upper two-thirds of the visible flank, characterized by a high-luminance upper edge and a lower-intensity shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached to the distal-posterior surface of the left pectoral fin.
